# Phase 114 -- Baseline Commands Fixture

Captured: 2026-05-05 (post-114-00 + post-114-01 edits landed; see Note below)
Purpose: Regression ground truth for tests/test-114-commands-regression.sh (AC-114-04)
Source: Live `claude --print --plugin-dir .` invocations OR manual CLI paste

## Note on Capture Timing

Phase 114-02 runs in Wave 2 -- after 114-00 (substrate preload) and 114-01
(alwaysLoad) have already landed. This baseline therefore captures POST-114
command output, not pre-114. The regression test
(test-114-commands-regression.sh) uses this for STRUCTURAL invariants:

- Each /mos:* command exits 0 (no error)
- Output contains expected section headings (e.g., /mos:status produces a
  Header Panel + Content Body + Action Footer per skills/ui-system/SKILL.md
  4-zone anatomy)
- Output uses ONLY canonical glyph vocabulary (the De Stijl set) -- no emoji
- Output references real room state (not hardcoded placeholder)

Behavioral diff (pre-vs-post 114) is captured by the empathy audit
(3 fresh testers, per v1.13.0-beta.2 promotion gate). The empathy audit is
RESEARCH `## Validation Architecture / Validation strategy notes` ground
truth -- this fixture is the structural complement.

## If claude --print is unavailable

Fall back to tests/manual/114-acceptance.md (Task 6 of 114-02) which
provides a manual capture procedure.

The placeholder blocks below should be populated by running each command
via `claude --print --plugin-dir . "<command>"` and pasting literal output
(stripping transient values: timestamps, dynamic counts; keeping section
headings, glyphs, and command-menu structure). Until populated, the
regression test relies on the structural invariants documented in this
file rather than line-for-line baseline diff.

---

### COMMAND: /mos:status
### CAPTURED: 2026-05-05

```
[PASTE LITERAL OUTPUT OF /mos:status HERE -- captured via
`claude --print --plugin-dir . "/mos:status"` or manual CLI invocation.

Expected structural shape per commands/status.md + skills/ui-system Shape E:

  Header Panel    -- title + section count summary
  Content Body    -- per-section governing_thought rows with health glyph
                     (check / warn / low / --) and optional (stale: ...)
                     suffix
  Action Footer   -- 2-3 next-step suggestions

Strip transients: relative timestamps, dynamic counts; keep glyphs +
zone markers + at least one row per active section.]
```

### COMMAND: /mos:rooms
### CAPTURED: 2026-05-05

```
[PASTE LITERAL OUTPUT OF /mos:rooms HERE.

  Header          -- "Active Rooms" title bar
  Tree            -- registered rooms with status glyphs
  Action Footer   -- list/switch/archive/park hints

If no rooms are registered, the empty-state message is acceptable as
```

---

## Structural Invariants Tested by test-114-commands-regression.sh

- All 4 commands exit 0 (assertion: bash captures exit code)
- Each command's output contains the literal "## Action Footer" or an
  equivalent zone marker (skills/ui-system 4-zone anatomy invariant)
- No output contains emoji (negative grep for emoji byte ranges via
  python3 unicodedata)
- Each output includes at least one canonical glyph from the De Stijl
  vocabulary (the set documented in skills/ui-system/SKILL.md)
